name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
notes: effort: the pipeline's generic levels (low, medium, max) mapped to the model card's reasoning_effort names; xhigh is this model's single top level.
sampling: the model card's recommended thinking-mode settings.
tool_arguments 'mapping': the chat template iterates tool-call arguments with |items, so the JSON string the API returns is parsed into an object before rendering.
Variants: OQT_VARIANT=<suffix> selects a fine-tune named <name>-<suffix> (for example Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-uncensored); see OQT.md, Models and variants.
